activity.notes: Neville Chamberlain served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 28 May 1937 to 10 May 1940. ATLAS records the premiership itself, not his lifespan or broader ministerial career.

sources.title: The Cabinet Papers — Neville Chamberlain 1937
sources.citation_text: The UK National Archives Cabinet Papers chronology gives Chamberlain's National Government as 28 May 1937 to 10 May 1940.

sources.citation_text: GOV.UK identifies Neville Chamberlain as Conservative Prime Minister in office from 1937 to 1940.
